title: They waited. Today's the day.
old_caption: They took it slowly, and today they said yes. The vows remember every season. The best toast of all: to choosing each other, every single day.

title: An Aquarius at 3 AM, headphones on.
old_caption:
Ever put headphones on at 3 AM just to turn the world down?
Aquarius isn't pulling away. It just needs someone who'll be quiet on the line with it.

title: POV: an Aquarius has a new theory before coffee.
old_caption:
Is cereal soup? An Aquarius has a whiteboard on it before coffee.
Your weird is not too much. It's the good part.

title: An Aquarius is in every group chat.
old_caption:
Twelve group chats and nobody to really talk to?
Aquarius learns to start a smaller chat with the friends who get it.

title: How an Aquarius flirts: 40 minutes about space.
old_caption:
Your date brought slides. Forty of them. About space.
The right person stays past slide three and asks for more.

title: An Aquarius just reinvented your workflow.
old_caption:
Ever had a coworker rebuild the whole system overnight?
Aquarius learns the best ideas are the ones you build together.

title: What an Aries thinks about at 3 AM.
old_caption:
Lying awake replaying something you said?
Aries drafts the sorry at 3 AM, sends it at 7. Some things can wait for morning. Rest first.

title: POV: an Aries’ alarm goes off.
old_caption:
Do you eat breakfast standing up, already halfway out the door?
Start fast if you want. Just sit down and eat first.

title: Never challenge an Aries to anything.
old_caption:
Ever lost a game and still had the best night?
Aries came in third at mini golf and laughed the whole way.

title: How an Aries flirts: a speedrun.
old_caption:
Asked someone out in four seconds, then waited forty minutes for a reply?
Bold is sweet, actually. Aries proves it.
